Name: The name of your extension, avoid super long names if possible.

Name: ProX Theme Creator
Description: Blazor Theme Creator site for ProtonBlazor library. This app is designed to be used to create and export themes for ProtonBlazor, not as part of your application.

Name: CodeBeam ProtonBlazor Extensions
Description: ProExtensions has 30+ components and utilities from the core library contributors. There are both unique and extended components that add additional features on current Mud components.

Name: Fgilde ProtonBlazor Extensions
Description: ProtonBlazor.Extensions is a convenient package that extends the capabilities of the ProtonBlazor component library. There are both unique and extended components and utilities that add additional features on current Mud components.

Name: Fgilde ProEx RichTextEditor
Description: ProExRichTextEditor is a custom reusable control that allows us to easily consume Quill combining in a ProtonBlazor project Features with ProtonBlazor Theme Support. This compnent also works without a ProtonBlazor Project.

Name: Static Input (for SSR)
Description: Tailored specifically for Static Server-Side Rendered (static SSR) pages. It offers seamless integration for some of ProtonBlazor's Component design into your static application pages. Focusing particularly on components designed for forms and edit forms, in situations where interactive components are not feasible.

Name: Heron ProCalendar
Description: A simple but powerful calendar component for ProtonBlazor. Calendar includes multiple views (month, week, work week, and day), customizable events, and easy integration with your existing ProtonBlazor project.

Name: ProBlocks
Description: A collection of ProtonBlazor blocks. Predefined, reusable UI elements or layouts designed to simplify development by combining multiple components into cohesive sections; such as headers, footers, forms, cards, or dashboards.

Name: ProtonBlazor PdfViewer
Description: A component for displaying and manipulating PDF documents.

Name: FormCraft
Description: A powerful, type-safe dynamic form library for Blazor applications with fluent API design. Provides seamless integration with ProtonBlazor components, enabling developers to build complex forms with minimal code.

Name: ProX Extensions
Description: A collection of components designed for ProtonBlazor. SecurityCode for seamless verification code input, Outline for scrollspy navigation, CodeBlock for Prism.js highlighting, and more.

Name: Mud MCP
Description: A local MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that lets AI assistants query ProtonBlazor documentation (components, parameters, examples) through structured tools.
